meta.title: Receptor
meta.author: Puryx (TBC)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Receptor by TBC (August 2008), a 4k intro that placed 2nd in the PC 4k intro competition at NVScene 2008 and was nominated for the Scene.org Award for best 4k intro (pouet 51449, Demozoo 31385). Music by Puryx; code and design by Mentor (the intro's nfo). It is played by Mentor's 4k synthesizer: per synth three oscillator pairs, an envelope, a pitch drop and noise, through a tree of filter, delay, distortion and mixer machines. 165 BPM, 3:15, 16 synths, 4015 notes. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the song file (music.asm) was converted by `synth-convert elevated` to the unified synth (pair oscillators, linear timed envelope, pitch drop; the machine tree as tracks, effect devices and mix buses) and imported with `song import` (notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the original synth code it differs by +0.22 dB loudness and at most 0.86 dB in any octave band, and it passes the timing check against a capture of the released intro (tools/elevated-parity). No source was released: the song file was carved from the intro's unpacked executable (tools/elevated-parity/carve.py). Its synth adds glides (a flagged note slides linearly in frequency to the next note of its pattern), played here as pitch-bend automation. Track names are derived here from each track's notes; the song file does not name them. No licence is stated for the music: it belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while the authors are asked for permission, and is removed at their request.
